problems: The blind guess ('loose abstract pale blue curves, no clear object') matches the render, not the intended lamp boat. Nothing reads as a boat or lantern at a glance.
The hull is small and sits at the bottom-left of the frame, while the sail and mast cluster in the middle-top, so the boat does not read as one object.

Labels overlap the figure and each other: 'bow of the hull', 'mast foot on the deck line', 'first lantern on the rope' and 'sail foot' all collide with strokes and with each other, which hides which star marks which part.
The sail is a narrow, crumpled shape with no clear full belly; star 8837 (belly) and star 9095 (sail foot) sit close together and look like one point, so the sail does not read as a sail.

The lantern rope runs from the far-left star 13847 through 12486, 12413 and 11407 in a zigzag. It reads as a wire or path rather than a hanging rope of lanterns, and the lanterns are not distinguishable from the other stars.
The masthead lantern (8882) and the mast top (9459) are close and the streamer tip (6867) is detached on the right. The masthead lantern is not clearly on a short pole above the yard.

The figure is roughly upright (hull at the bottom, sail and mast above), so orientation is acceptable. The blue silhouette strokes sit under the gold lines, so this is not a bare copy of the gold lines, but the silhouette is too thin and broken to carry the form.
